reviewers.verified_scope: Causal control authority, actual facility-versus-BESS attribution, work conservation, hard-case thermal and SOC outcomes, recovery.

reviewers.role: Adversarial SAC implementation and learning review
reviewers.verified_scope: SAC update counts and pairing, optimizer/checkpoint invariants, early selection, late degradation, and exact BC-initializer contrasts.
Date/seed separation, actual training exposure, hash chain, model lock, complete case inventory and one-shot final evaluation.

implemented_guard_resolutions: Strict native action bounds and named observation/checkpoint contracts.
Original training dates enforced for fixed and curriculum cases.
Configured service horizon restored before every training reset.
True finite-task endpoints and exact update/transition bookkeeping.
Separate BC-only results and unchanged actor during critic calibration.
Post-update checkpoint selection with all development cases retained.
Physical and economic recovery, independent of the service SOC gate.
Model/data/source hashes checked before and after training and final evaluation.
Explicit unavailable seed slots and no survivor-only method mean.
Nonmutating gradient/std telemetry and immediate calibration logging.
claims_explicitly_rejected_or_narrowed: No iid t-tests, confidence intervals, or statistical equivalence claims.
No causal explanation of critic/actor drift inferred from Q magnitude alone.
No claim that the online RL phase beats its BC initializer on tracking.
No global dominance, accredited capacity, emissions, or business-profit claim.
No change of primary measurement boundary or main panel to favor a result.
Original peak dates remain consumed regression evidence.
Fresh calendar cases do not imply unseen workload phases.
Thermal state closure is real, but constant HVAC draw does not price excursion depth.
The analytic tracking outlier is finite actuator saturation, not a hidden power credit.
outcome: Verified controller-pipeline improvements over legacy comparators, with stronger analytic/BC baselines and all tradeoffs retained.
scope_limit: Adversarial review and tests are evidence, not a guarantee that every possible defect or deployment risk is absent.
